title: Where do you stand?
caption: Four questions, half a minute, on your phone.

poll.qrLabel: QR code to the directpoll vote page
poll.notice: anonymous – we only count answers; they feed a later analysis
poll.resultsHint: Loads from directpoll.com only after the click.

model.question: What is AI most like for you?

answers.search: Search engine – just smarter, gives answers
answers.chat: Chat – a conversation partner for my questions
answers.assistant: Assistant – works along inside my tools
answers.colleague: Colleague – I let it take over whole tasks
answers.factory: Factory – an AI organisation running for me

fluency.question: How would you rate your AI fluency?

answers.advanced: Advanced – I build agents and harnesses
answers.expert: Expert – run agent systems in production

scope.question: What do you have a say in when it comes to AI?

answers.self: My own work – just for me

usage.question: What's the most advanced thing you do with AI today?

answers.none: Nothing yet – haven't used AI yet
answers.ask: Chat – ask questions, have text written
answers.documents: My own documents – upload, revise together
answers.embedded: In my tools – AI in office, mail, editor
answers.delegate: Hand over tasks – AI does several steps
answers.build: Build my own agents – workflows for my work
answers.orchestrate: Several agents – run and orchestrate in parallel
answers.product: Build AI products – for customers or users

talking-points.description: Scan the code, four questions, half a minute, one answer each: what AI is most like for you, how you rate your AI fluency, what you have a say in when it comes to AI, and the most advanced thing you do with it today. Anonymous, only answers are counted; the numbers go into an analysis after the webinar (AIE-0016). The results load only on click, so nothing goes to directpoll before.
